d: Light blue, shoulder-length hair with soft texture and long bangs that frame the face, complemented by a youthful, adolescent face and a slender build. Large, expressive deep crimson eyes pair with an orange headpiece adorned with two tall, translucent blue crystalline protrusions. The outfit consists of a white cape with a blue lining, a dark brown sleeveless top with gold trim and a red gem accent, and long orange gloves.
